thread:
Kara: dropped a small tweak proposal for the keys create flow. two asks: make the one-time reveal harder to miss, and avoid accidental rotates in the bulk picker. mock: https://design.redwood.local/mock/keys-acknowledge-v1.png

Devon: +1. idea: after create show a persistent anchored panel with heading 'Save this key now' and two actions: 'Download key' (primary) and a full-width secondary 'I saved it' so people explicitly acknowledge. also show a copy input with a visible Copy button.

Anya: agree. keyboard behavior: focus goes to the copy input on reveal, Copy announces "Copied to clipboard" with aria-live=polite. if the user navigates away without acknowledging show a small interrupt: "You haven't saved your key" toast (modal only if they try to leave the page).

Irina: accessibility nit: if the panel blocks workflow use role="dialog" aria-modal=true. If not blocking, role="region" with aria-label. Undo for revoke should be inline: row collapses to 'Key revoked 7 undo' for 15s. role="status" + aria-live set depending on impact (assertive if traffic blocked). ensure revoke is always last in overflow DOM order.

Kara: bulk rotate idea: for <=3 keys show combined modal with checkbox 'I understand this will invalidate the selected keys'. for >3 keys require typed-confirm 'ROTATE' to prevent mass outages. show an optional toggle 'Update linked secrets managers' so teams can opt in.

Devon: copy suggestions: primary Create label: 'Create API key' not just 'Create'. download button: 'Download key'. acknowledgment: 'I saved this key'. revoke heading: 'Revoke API key' body: 'This will immediately invalidate the key.' undo toast: 'Key revoked  undo'. keep verb-first language.

Anya: mobile note: overflow menu spacing is tight. separate danger group with divider and increase hit targets to 44px. require extra confirm on mobile revokes (checkbox) to reduce fat-fingers.

Design-bot: automated checks: focus-trap on drawer: FAIL (needs fix); aria-live for copy: MISSING; callout contrast: WARN. Uploaded: keys-acknowledge-v1.fig (https://design.redwood.local/file/keys-acknowledge-v1)

Kara: thanks — I'll update the prototype to include persistent anchored panel, full-width 'I saved this key' acknowledgment, typed-confirm rules for bulk rotate, and bigger mobile hit targets. @Irina can you run a quick SR pass after I push v2? :thumbsup:
